description: A team of research and coding. We have 2 people who code the software we are developing and 3 who do research on the softwares that exist.
summary:
Our project is an AI-powered health monitoring system. The system continuously monitors an astronaut's vital signs, including body temperature and heart rate. Body temperature is measured using sensors attached to the astronaut's spacesuit, while heart rate is monitored through a smart bracelet.

The collected data is displayed on a screen in the astronaut's casket. An AI system analyzes these measurements and detects unusual changes that could indicate a potential health problem. If an emergency is detected, the AI immediately sends alerts to the other astronauts so they can respond quickly and provide assistance.
details:
Our project is an AI-powered health monitoring system. It collects data from a sensor in the bracelet and it shows the measurements on the screen in the casket.

This allows them to track their health conditions in real time and it also allows other astronouts to intervene if a health problem occurs.

For the codes of the AI that we named TOT we used Claude for the temple.
